title: 图鉴与首领资料（图鉴与装备）（第 2／3 部分）

rows.source: [LOTS OF THOSE RED FURRED FERAL CANINES AROUND, HUH?]
rows.current: Bossu: [周围这种红毛野犬还真不少，是吧？]

rows.source: [THOSE FEISTY FELLAS ARE CALLED "BARKERS".]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些带劲儿的家伙叫「吠犬」。]

rows.source: [EEP! YOU'D THINK THEY MISTOOK ME FOR ONE OF THEIR OWN]
rows.current: Yiffany: [咿！它们简直把我当成了同类，]

rows.source: [WITH THE WAY THEY WERE NIPPING AT ME...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [围着我一口一口地咬……]

rows.source: [WELL, THERE IS MORE THAN A PASSING RESEMBLANCE...]
rows.current: Bossu: [嗯，还真不止一点点像……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [OH LOOK, IT'S ONE OF YOUR FAVORITES AGAIN!]
rows.current: Bossu: [哟，瞧瞧，又是你最喜欢的那一种！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [VEEERY FUNNY, BOSS. JUST HOW MANY BIGBOLDS ARE THERE?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [很——好笑啊，老大。到底有多少只大壮兽？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [PRACTICALLY INNU- MERABLE. THEY'RE ONE OF THE ALPHA]
rows.current: Bossu: [几乎数不清。它们是图托恩下层的优势物种之一。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SPECIES OF THE LOWER LEVELS OF TUTONE.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT'S QUITE RARE TO SEE THEM THIS CLOSE TO THE SURFACE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [在离地表这么近的地方见到它们，相当罕见。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [REALLY? I BUMPED INTO ONE REAL QUICK JUST AFTER LANDING.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [真的？我刚落地就马上撞见了一只。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [SOME OF THE TREMORS MUST'VE DISRUPTED A NEST OF 'EM!]
rows.current: Mauser: [那几次震动肯定把它们的巢给震散了！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [AS BIG AND BULKY AS THEY ARE, IF ONE OF THEIR ROUTES]
rows.current: Mauser: [它们这么大块头又笨重，要是它们常走的路被截断了，能选的路可没你那么多。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [GETS CUT OFF, THEY DON'T HAVE AS MANY OPTIONS AS YOU DO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [FAAAAAIR...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [有——道理……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [JUST BE CAREFUL WITH THEM, YIFFANY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [跟它们打交道小心点，伊吠妮。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS TEMPTING AS IT MAY BE TO CAPTURE ONE FOR STUDYING]
rows.current: Bossu: [抓一只回去研究虽然很诱人，但你在这么深处遇到的，肯定比你之前追过的那只大壮兽还要强。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY YOU FIND THIS DEEP DOWN ARE SURE TO BE EVEN STRONGER]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAN THE BIGBOLD YOU CHASED DOWN BEFORE.]
[BOSSU! THIS IS AGENT YIFFAI, REQUESTING SUPPORT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏！我是特工伊吠，请求支援！]

rows.source: [BOSSU HERE, WHAT'S THE PROBLEM, AGENT?]
rows.current: Bossu: [波苏 在此，出什么问题了，特工？]

rows.source: [I'VE ENCOUNTERED A HAYWIRE DRONE THAT SEEMS TO NEVER]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我碰上一架失控的无人机，即使在我把它们打爆之后，它们还是不停地刷出来。]

rows.source: [STOP SPAWNING AFTER I'VE DESTROYED THEM.]
[MUCH OF THE ROBOTIC MATERIAL IN THAT OLD SPACE STATION]
rows.current: Bossu: [那座旧太空站里的大量机械材料，都配有纳米机械回收系统。]

rows.source: [ARE BUILT WITH NANOMECHANICAL RECYCLING SYSTEMS.]
[NA-NO-MY-HUH?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [纳——诺——什么玩意儿？]

rows.source: [BASICALLY THEY'RE DESIGNED TO SELF REPAIR ENDLESSLY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [简单说，它们被设计成能无休止地自我修复。]

rows.source: [IT USED TO BE A POPULAR LOW- MAINTENANCE DESIGN]
rows.current: Bossu: [这种低维护设计以前很受欢迎，直到人们发现，等它们过时了，根本没法拆开。]

rows.source: [UNTIL IT WAS REALIZED THAT THEY COULDN'T BE TAKEN]
[APART WHEN THEY BECAME OBSOLETE.]
[THEY REPAIR THEM- SELVES FASTER THAN WE CAN BREAK EM!]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们自我修复得比我们拆得还快！]

rows.source: [THAT SOUNDS REALLY ANNOYING!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [听起来真是够烦人的！]

rows.source: [IT WAS. THAT'S WHY YOU DON'T SEE SUCH MACHINERY BACK]
rows.current: Bossu: [确实烦。所以你在老家还待在地面上、没上天时，看不到这种机器。]

rows.source: [AT HOME WHILE TERRA- BOUND.]
[SO IT'S POINTLESS TO TRY DESTROY THEM ALL...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那想把它们全毁掉也是白费力气……]

rows.source: [GOOD TO KNOW! YIFFAI OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [长见识了！伊吠通话完毕。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE SILVERY SPIKED ROBOS ARE CALLED "SPIKERS"]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些银色带刺的机器人叫做“SPIKERS”]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY'RE ARE A BIT OF A NUISANCE, AREN'T THEY?]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们还真有点烦人，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WHILE THOSE LOOK LIKE BUGS CRAWLING ON THE GROUND]
rows.current: Bossu: [虽然它们看起来像在地上爬的虫子，其实那是精巧的机械仿制品。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY ARE ACTUALLY A CLEVER MECHA FASCIMILE.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WE DON'T HAVE ENOUGH DATA TO SAY WHO MADE THEM]
rows.current: Bossu: [我们手上的资料不足以判断是谁造的，所以在那之前，先小心它们的刺吧。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SO JUST WATCH OUT FOR THEIR SPIKES IN THE MEANTIME.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [A VICIOUS, REGROWING PLANT CALLED THE "BULBER"]
rows.current: Bossu: [一种名为「球茎怪」的凶恶、会反复再生的植物，会朝任何靠近的陌生动物开火。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WILL SHOOT AT ANY UNKNOWN FAUNA THAT COMES NEARBY.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT INCLUDES YOU, AGENT, SO BEST TO TAKE CARE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [也包括你，特工，所以最好多加小心。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THERE ARE REPORTS THAT A "HOPPER" THAT ABSORBS ENOUGH]
rows.current: Bossu: [有报道称，一只「跳跃者」只要吸收了足够的灵能，就会变成「牛蛙」，能从远处朝目标喷吐泡泡，甚至还能用新长出来的修长舌头造成伤害。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [PSYCHIC ENERGY WILL TURN INTO A "BULLFROG"]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CAPABLE OF SHOOTING BUBBLES AT TARGETS FROM AFAR OR EVEN]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DEALING DAMAGE WITH THEIR NEW, ELONGATED TONGUE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SOUNDS TRICKY...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [听着挺棘手……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [FORTUNATELY WATER IS SCARCE IN THAT SECTOR OF SCEAFYA]
rows.current: Bossu: [幸运的是，斯凯菲亚那片区域缺水，否则你还得提防它们连你一起伏击呢！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [OR YOU'D HAVE TO WORRY ABOUT THEM AMBUSHING YOU TOO!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [EVEN MORE OF THESE...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这种东西还真多……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE BUMPERS IN THAT SECTION SEEM TO HAVE BETTER ARMOR]
rows.current: Bossu: [那一区的弹跳机，装甲似乎比你之前见过的同类更好。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAN THE OTHER BUMPERS YOU'VE SEEN.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [TRY NOT TO LET THEM HIT YOU, SINCE THAT EXTRA PLATING]
rows.current: Bossu: [尽量别被撞到，因为那层额外装甲肯定也会造成额外伤害。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IS SURE TO RESULT IN EXTRA DAMAGE, TOO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [EVEN MORE OF THESE...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [还有更多这种东西……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE BUMPERS IN THAT SECTION SEEM TO HAVE BETTER ARMOR]
rows.current: Bossu: [那一区的弹跳机，装甲似乎比你见过的其他弹跳机都要好。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAN THE OTHER BUMPERS YOU'VE SEEN.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [TRY NOT TO LET THEM HIT YOU, SINCE THAT EXTRA PLATING]
rows.current: Bossu: [尽量别让它们撞到你，因为那层额外装甲肯定也会带来额外伤害。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IS SURE TO RESULT IN EXTRA DAMAGE, TOO.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE MACHINES BUMPING UP AND DOWN INCESSANTLY]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些不停上下弹跳的机器，是某种目前出现了故障的巡逻机器人。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ARE SOME SORT OF PATROL DROIDS THAT ARE CURRENTLY]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MALFUNCTIONING.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY SHOULDN'T POSE A THREAT, JUST TRY TO AVOID THEM.]
rows.current: Bossu: [应该不构成威胁，尽量避开就好。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT? CAN'T I DESTROY THEM?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [什么？我不能把它们毁掉吗？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T BE SO BRASH. SOMETIMES AVOIDING CONFLICT IS BEST.]
rows.current: Bossu: [别这么莽撞。有时避开冲突才是上策。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [R-RIGHT, I'LL TRY TO BE MINDFUL...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对、对，我会多留意的……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [GOOD LAD.]
rows.current: Bossu: [好小伙子。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE MACHINES BUMPING UP AND DOWN INCESSANTLY]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些不停上下弹跳的机器，似乎是某种目前出了故障的巡逻机器人。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ARE SOME SORT OF PATROL DROIDS THAT ARE CURRENTLY]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MALFUNCTIONING.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY SHOULDN'T POSE A THREAT, JUST TRY TO AVOID THEM.]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们应该构不成威胁，尽量避开就好。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HEY BOSSU? THE TURRETS HERE SEEM KINDA FAMILIAR.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，波苏？这里的炮塔好像有点眼熟。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [DIDN'T WE USE SOMETHING SIMILAR, BACK IN... UMM...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我们是不是也用过类似的，在……嗯……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BACK IN TRAINING, THAT'S RIGHT YIFFAI.]
rows.current: Bossu: [在训练的时候，没错，伊吠。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT MODEL OF TURRET HAS BEEN STANDARD ISSUE FOR]
rows.current: Bossu: [那种型号的炮塔作为制式装备，已经用了大约两个世纪。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE LAST COUPLE OF CENTURIES OR SO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [A COUPLE OF CENTURIES?? NO WAY!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [两个世纪？？不可能吧！！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YES WAY. NOBODY'S BOTHERED TRYING TO REPLACE THOSE OLD]
rows.current: Bossu: [当然有可能。没人费心去换那些老旧的自卫武器。它们几乎从来不会坏，你也看到了！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SELF DEFENSE WEAPONS. THEY ALMOST NEVER BREAK DOWN,]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS YOU CAN SEE!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THEY BREAK DOWN PRETTY EASILY IF I HIT THEM ENOUGH...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [只要我多敲几下，它们坏得还挺容易……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BOSSU, ARE THERE CANNONS STRONGER OR AM I WEAKER?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏，是这些加农炮变强了，还是我变弱了？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THESE CANNONS SEEM TO HAVE GONE A WHILE WITHOUT]
rows.current: Bossu: [这些加农炮似乎已经有一段时间不需要自行修复了。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NEEDING TO BE SELF- REPAIRED.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CONSEQUENTLY THEY SEEM TO BE FIRING AT HIGHER POWER.]
rows.current: Bossu: [因此它们似乎正以更高的功率发射。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GREEAAAAAT, JUST WHAT I NEEDED TO DEAL WITH...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [太——好了，偏偏又摊上这种麻烦……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BOSSU, ARE THERE CANNONS STRONGER OR AM I WEAKER?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [波苏，是这里的炮变强了，还是我变弱了？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THESE CANNONS SEEM TO HAVE GONE A WHILE WITHOUT]
rows.current: Bossu: [这些加农炮似乎已经有一段时间不需要自行修复了。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NEEDING TO BE SELF- REPAIRED.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CONSEQUENTLY THEY SEEM TO BE FIRING AT HIGHER POWER.]
rows.current: Bossu: [因此它们似乎正以更高的功率发射。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GREEAAAAAT, JUST WHAT I NEEDED TO DEAL WITH...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [太——好了，还嫌麻烦不够多是吧……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BOSSU, ARE THERE CANNONS STRONGER OR AM I WEAKER?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏，是有更强的加农炮，还是我变弱了？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THESE CANNONS SEEM TO HAVE GONE A WHILE WITHOUT]
rows.current: Bossu: [这些加农炮似乎已经有一段时间不需要自行修复了。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NEEDING TO BE SELF- REPAIRED.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CONSEQUENTLY THEY SEEM TO BE FIRING AT HIGHER POWER.]
rows.current: Bossu: [因此它们似乎正以更高的功率发射。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GREEAAAAAT, JUST WHAT I NEEDED TO DEAL WITH...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [真——棒，这麻烦来得可真是时候……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS A NANOMECHANICAL ROBOT, THE 'DRILLER' UNITS WILL]
rows.current: Bossu: [作为一种纳米机械机器人，那些'DRILLER'单元会持续自我修复。它们会不知疲倦地钻掘。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CONTINUOUSLY REPAIR THEMSELVES. THEY'LL BURROW TIRELESSLY.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WELL I GUESS THAT MEANS I JUST HAVE TO MAKE AN]
rows.current: Yiffany: [那我猜我就只能开一个口子，然后跑掉！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OPENING AND THEN RUN FOR IT!]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED, AGENT. THE DRILLER UNITS WILL ONLY OPERATE WITHIN]
rows.current: Bossu: [的确，特工。DRILLER单元只在预定范围内活动，不会越界。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEIR PREDETERMINED BOUNDARIES.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [...WISH MORE GUYS AT THE ACADEMY HAD BEEN LIKE THAT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……真希望学院里能多些这么懂得分寸的男生。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [HMM?]
rows.current: Bossu: [嗯？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NOTHING BOSSU! YIFFANY OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [没什么，波苏！伊吠妮通话完毕。]

rows.source: [AS A NANOMECHANICAL ROBOT, THE 'DRILLER' UNITS WILL]
rows.current: Bossu: [作为一种纳米机械机器人，那些'DRILLER'单元会持续自我修复。它们会不知疲倦地钻掘。]

rows.source: [CONTINUOUSLY REPAIR THEMSELVES. THEY'LL BURROW TIRELESSLY.]
[WELL I GUESS THAT MEANS I JUST HAVE TO MAKE AN]
rows.current: Yiffany: [那我猜我就只能开一个口子，然后跑掉！]

rows.source: [OPENING AND THEN RUN FOR IT!]
[INDEED, AGENT. THE DRILLER UNITS WILL ONLY OPERATE WITHIN]
rows.current: Bossu: [的确，特工。DRILLER单元只会在它们预定的边界之内运作。]

rows.source: [THEIR PREDETERMINED BOUNDARIES.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GRR. JUST RAN INTO A DWARF DOWN HERE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [啧。刚在下面碰上个矮人。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WE HAVE NO PAST REPORTS OF DWARVES IN THE AREA]
rows.current: Bossu: [过去没有这片区域出现矮人的报告，不过他们确实很会嗅出稀有矿藏。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY DO TEND TO SNIFF OUT RARE ORE DEPOSITS.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SOUNDS LIKE YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH THEM?]
rows.current: Bossu: [听起来你跟他们打过交道？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [DUDE I MET AT A BAR. ALWAYS MOPING ABOUT ALL THE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [酒吧认识过一个。他老是为自己赌博输光的那些黄金和珠宝唉声叹气……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GOLD AND JEWELS HE'D GAMBLED AWAY...]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [OH. WELL THAT HARDLY SEEMS PERTINENT TO-]
rows.current: Bossu: [哦。不过这跟眼下的事没什么——]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AND HE *NEVER* WARNED ME WHEN HE WAS ABOUT TO CUM!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [而且他要射的时候，*从来不*提前说一声！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [JUST WHAM, ALL OVER MY CLOTHES OR GEAR! TCH!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [啪的一下，就射得我衣服装备上全都是！啧！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [D-DOES SOUND LIKE AN INCONSIDERATE FELLOW...]
rows.current: Bossu: [听、听起来确实挺不体贴的……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HMPH... YIFFANY OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哼……伊吠妮通话完毕。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE ELVES OF SCEAFYA MAY ALL BE FEMALE]
rows.current: Bossu: [斯凯菲亚的精灵虽说全是雌性，却并非个个都能长生不死。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY AREN'T ALL IMMORTAL.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS THEY CAN BREED WITH ANY MALE OF ANY SPECIES]
rows.current: Bossu: [她们能与任何物种的雄性繁殖，因此也逐渐带上了越来越多寿命有限的生物的特征。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY'VE TAKEN ON MORE AND MORE MORTAL CHARACTERISTICS]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WAIT, SO THAT MEANS SOME OF THEM *ARE* IMMORTAL?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [等等，也就是说，她们中还真有*长生不死*的？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED, AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL.]
rows.current: Bossu: [根据目前掌握的情况，是的。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY ELF THAT IS OUT IN THE OPEN AND ENGAGING IN COMBAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些在外头露面、参与战斗的精灵，无疑都还年轻，最多也就一百岁。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WILL NO DOUBT BE A YOUNGSTER. A HUNDRED YEARS OLD AT MOST.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THAT'S... WOW...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这……哇……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T GIVE IN TO AWE. YOU'LL NEED TO BE ON YOUR TOES]
rows.current: Bossu: [别光顾着吃惊。想挡住这些年轻精灵的攻击，你得时刻留神。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO REPEL THE YOUNG ELVES' ATTACKS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [RIGHT, GOTTA FOCUS.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [对，得专注。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE ELVES OF SCEAFYA MAY ALL BE FEMALE]
rows.current: Bossu: [斯凯菲亚的精灵虽说全是雌性，却并不个个长生不老。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY AREN'T ALL IMMORTAL.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS THEY CAN BREED WITH ANY MALE OF ANY SPECIES]
rows.current: Bossu: [她们能与任何物种的雄性繁衍，因此逐渐带上了会衰老、会死亡的特征。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY'VE TAKEN ON MORE AND MORE MORTAL CHARACTERISTICS]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WAIT, SO THAT MEANS SOME OF THEM *ARE* IMMORTAL?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [等等，也就是说，她们中有些*真能*长生不老？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED, AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL.]
rows.current: Bossu: [没错，至少据我们目前所知是这样。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY ELF THAT IS OUT IN THE OPEN AND ENGAGING IN COMBAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [任何一个在开阔处并且正在交战的精灵，无疑会是个年幼者。顶多一百岁。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WILL NO DOUBT BE A YOUNGSTER. A HUNDRED YEARS OLD AT MOST.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT'S... WOW...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这……哇……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T GIVE IN TO AWE. YOU'LL NEED TO BE ON YOUR TOES]
rows.current: Bossu: [别光顾着惊叹。打起精神，才能挡住那些年轻精灵的攻击。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO REPEL THE YOUNG ELVES' ATTACKS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [RIGHT, GOTTA FOCUS.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对，得专注。]

rows.source: [THE ELVES OF SCEAFYA MAY ALL BE FEMALE]
rows.current: Bossu: [斯凯菲亚的精灵也许全是雌性，但她们并不全是不朽的。]

rows.source: [BUT THEY AREN'T ALL IMMORTAL.]
[THEY'VE TAKEN ON MORE AND MORE MORTAL CHARACTERISTICS]
rows.current: Bossu: [几百年过去，]

rows.source: [AS THE CENTURIES HAVE GONE BY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [她们身上凡俗的特征也越来越多。]

rows.source: [WAIT, SO THAT MEANS SOME OF THEM *ARE* IMMORTAL?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [等等，那就是说，她们中有些*真是*不朽的？]

rows.source: [INDEED, AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL.]
rows.current: Bossu: [据我们掌握的情况，确实如此。]

rows.source: [ANY ELF THAT IS OUT IN THE OPEN AND ENGAGING IN COMBAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [在外面公开露面、参与战斗的精灵，无疑都是年轻一辈，最多一百岁。]

rows.source: [WILL NO DOUBT BE A YOUNGSTER. A HUNDRED YEARS OLD AT MOST.]
[THAT'S... WOW...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这……哇……]

rows.source: [DON'T GIVE IN TO AWE. YOU'LL NEED TO BE ON YOUR TOES]
rows.current: Bossu: [别光顾着惊叹。想挡住那些年轻精灵的攻击，你得时刻保持警觉。]

rows.source: [IN ORDER TO REPEL THE YOUNG ELVES' ATTACKS.]
[RIGHT, GOTTA FOCUS.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对，得专注。]

rows.source: [COME IN. BOSSU?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [呼叫波苏，收到请回答？]

rows.source: [WHAT SEEMS TO BE THE PROBLEM?]
rows.current: Bossu: [似乎出了什么问题？]

rows.source: [I'VE COME ACROSS A BI- PEDAL CANID SPECIES THAT SEEMS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我遇到了一种双足的犬科物种，它好像完全无视我所有的沟通尝试！]

rows.source: [TO BE IGNORING ALL MY ATTEMPTS AT COMMUNICATION!]
[NOT ONLY THAT, THEY'RE THROWING ROCKS AT ME!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [而且它们还朝我扔石头！！]

rows.source: [THEY MAY LOOK ORGANIC, BUT BELIEVE IT OR NOT THOSE ARE]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们看着像有机生物，可你信不信，那些是图托恩某个物种的机械复制品——Fenfen。]

rows.source: [MECHANICAL COPIES OF A TUTONE SPECIES, THE FENFEN.]
[YOU MEAN LIKE... A DRONE, OR A TURRET?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你是说……像无人机，或者炮塔那样？]

rows.source: [RIGHT. IF ANY FLESH AND FUR VARIETIES OF THAT SPECIES ARE]
rows.current: Bossu: [对。要是那物种还有血肉皮毛的真货留在这颗星球上，也还没有特工碰到过它们。]

rows.source: [STILL ON THE PLA- NET, NO AGENTS HAVE RUN INTO THEM YET.]
[REPORTS OF FENFEN OUTFITS STREWN ABOUT ARE ALL WE HAVE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [我们只有那些关于 FENFEN 服装散落各处的报告。]

rows.source: [THAT'S CRAZY...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [太离谱了……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [A SWEEP OF YOUR WEAPON MAY EXTINGUISH FIRES]
rows.current: Bossu: [用武器横扫也许能扑灭矿井里的火焰，不过火势必然会重新燃起。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IN THE MINES, BUT THEY WILL INVARIABLY REIGNITE.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE ROTUND HOVERING DRONES ARE SIMILAR TO THE ONES]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些圆滚滚的悬浮无人机，和你见过在泽罗尼亚周围飞的那种很像。不过，这一型号还配备了爆炸载荷。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU SAW FLYING AROUND ZERONIA. HOWEVER, THIS MODEL]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IS ALSO EQUIPPED WITH AN EXPLOSIVE PAYLOAD.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU MAY WISH TO ENGAGE THEM WITH RANGED ATTACKS.]
rows.current: Bossu: [你或许可以用远程攻击来对付它们。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HERE I THOUGHT STATIONARY MINES WERE BAD, NOW]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我刚还觉得固定地雷够糟的了，现在它们居然朝我飞过来了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THEY'RE FLYING AT ME!]
[THOSE GHOSTLY HEADS THAT RISE FROM THE GROUND...]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些从地里冒出来的幽灵头颅……]

rows.source: [LET'S CALL THEM "GHOSTERS" FOR NOW.]
rows.current: Bossu: [暂且叫它们「幽灵者」吧。]

rows.source: [REALLY? THAT'S THE BEST YOU CAN DO?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [真的吗？你就只能想出这个了？]

rows.source: [L-LOOK, THE IMPORTANT THING IS THAT THESE ENEMIES]
rows.current: Bossu: [你、你看，重要的是这些敌人似乎在无休止地涌现。]

rows.source: [SEEM TO BE SPAWNING ENDLESSLY.]
[IT'S ALMOST LIKE THEY'RE MANIFESTATIONS OF]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们简直就像是被扰乱的灵能的化身……]

rows.source: [DISTURBED PSYCHIC ENERGY...]
[EITHER WAY, BE CAREFUL, AGENT!]
rows.current: Bossu: [不管怎样，小心点，特工！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE HOPPING AGGRESSIVE CREATURES...]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些蹦来蹦去、很有攻击性的生物……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [LET'S CALL THEM "HOPPERS" FOR NOW.]
rows.current: Bossu: [暂时就叫它们“跳跃者”吧。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ORIGINAL, BUT GO ON.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [真有创意。接着说。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY WERE ONCE ORDINARY FROGS FROM TUTONE]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们原本是来自图托恩的普通青蛙，但似乎有某种能量注入它们体内，给了它们一种特别的韧性和攻击性……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT IT SEEMS SOME SORT OF ENERGY HAS INFUSED THEM WITH]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [A SPECIAL TYPE OF RESILIENCE AND AGGRESSION...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WITH ALL THE PSYCHIC ANOMALIES I'VE COME ACROSS]
rows.current: Yiffany: [碰上这么多灵能异常之后，我开始琢磨到底还有什么*没*被影响了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I'M STARTING TO WONDER WHAT *HASN'T* BECOME AFFECTED.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED. IF YOU HAVE A WAY TO DEAL WITH SUCH CREATURES]
rows.current: Bossu: [确实。如果你有对付这类生物的办法，最好也把它用到跳跃者身上。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT'S BEST THAT YOU PUT IT TO USE ON THE HOPPERS TOO.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NO INFO, BECAUSE YOU CAN'T KILL IT.]
rows.current: Bossu: [没有情报，因为你杀不死它。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BOSSU, REQUESTING IMMEDIATE UPDATE ON CONDITIONS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏，请求立即更新当前情况，以确认我并非水生生物。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [TO VERIFY THAT I AM NOT AN AQUATIC BEING.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T WORRY YIFFAI, YOU ARE STILL 100% DOG.]
rows.current: Bossu: [放心，伊吠，你还是百分百的狗。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE STRANGE HAPPE- NINGS ON TUTONE HAVE LEAD TO]
rows.current: Bossu: [图托恩上发生的怪事，导致有人目击到非实体的水母，这也许会让你产生别的想法。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SIGHTINGS OF NON- PHYSICAL JELLY FISH]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WHICH MIGHT BE CAUSING YOU TO THINK OTHERWISE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THEY SEEM PLENTY PHYSICAL TO ME, OW...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [在我看来它们相当实体，哎哟……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ON THE CONTRARY, IF YOU'RE TO BELIEVE THE REPORTS...]
rows.current: Bossu: [恰恰相反，如果那些报告可信的话……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY CREATURE FLASHING OMINOUSLY PURPLE ON TUTONE]
rows.current: Bossu: [图托恩上任何闪着不祥紫光的生物，其实都是灵能动荡产生的幻象。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IS ACTUALLY AN APPARITION OF PSYCHIC TURMOIL.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [HOW YOU DEAL WITH THEM, WE CANNOT SAY FROM HERE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [至于你该怎么应付它们，我们从这边说不准。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HMM, PSYCHIC, YOU SAY.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嗯，你说是灵能造成的？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GUESS I'LL HAVE TO FIGURE IT OUT MYSELF...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [看来只能我自己想办法搞清楚了……]

rows.source: [BOSSU! I'VE RUN INTO SOME ANTHRO GREEN LIZARD UNITS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏！我遇到了一批人形绿蜥蜴兵，看着可一点都不友好！]

rows.source: [BUT THEY SEEM DECIDEDLY UNFRIENDLY!]
[AHH YOU'VE RUN INTO SOME KOBOLDS DOWN THERE, HAVE YOU?]
rows.current: Bossu: [啊，你在下面撞上科博德了，是吧？]

rows.source: [IS THAT WHAT THESE BIG LIZARD FOLKS ARE?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这些大蜥蜴家伙就是科博德？]

rows.source: [CORRECT. YOU BETTER GET USED TO TANGLING WITH THEM.]
rows.current: Bossu: [没错。你最好习惯跟他们缠斗。]

rows.source: [THOSE LIZARDS ARE A SLY BUNCH, KNOWN FOR PIRACY AND SLAVING]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些蜥蜴狡猾得很，干海盗和贩奴的勾当出了名，还干任何到最后能赚到LECT的营生！]

rows.source: [AND ANYTHING ELSE THAT HAS A LECT PAYOFF AT THE END!]
[YOU'RE LIABLE TO RUN INTO THEM ON MOST ANY SORTIE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [你随便出趟任务都可能撞上他们。]

rows.source: [I CAN HANDLE THEM! I'VE ALREADY TAKEN OUT, LIKE...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我应付得了他们！我已经干掉了，大概……]

rows.source: [...A BUNCH!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……一大把！]

rows.source: [BOSSU, REPORTING A GREEN LIZARD TAIL SIGHTING.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [波苏，报告发现一条绿色蜥蜴尾巴。]

rows.source: [AHH YOU'VE RUN INTO SOME KOBOLDS DOWN THERE, HAVE YOU?]
rows.current: Bossu: [啊，你在下面碰上科博德了是吧？]

rows.source: [THIS ISN'T THE FIRST TIME I'VE HAD CONTACT WITH THEM]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我跟它们打交道不是头一回了，但没想到它们会出现在这颗星球上！]

rows.source: [BUT I WASN'T EXPECTING THEM TO BE ON THIS PLANET!]
[THOSE LIZARDS ARE A SLY BUNCH, KNOWN FOR PIRACY AND SLAVING]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些蜥蜴狡猾得很，干海盗和贩奴的勾当出了名，凡是最后能捞到 lect 的事，他们都干！]

rows.source: [AND ANYTHING ELSE THAT HAS A LECT PAYOFF AT THE END!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WOAH! DID YOU PICK UP THAT EXPLOSION AT HQ?!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哇！总部听见刚才那声爆炸了吗？！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED, IT APPEARS THE MINES OF TUTONE HAVE BEEN MINED.]
rows.current: Bossu: [听见了。看来图托恩的矿井里都埋了mine。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...? WELL SURE, BUT WHAT'S THAT GOTTA DO WITH EXPLOSIONS?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……？矿井里当然有矿，可这跟爆炸有什么关系？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE EXPLOSIONS FROM THE MINES.]
rows.current: Bossu: [我说的是mine炸了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH! IT WAS IN THE MINES, BUT-]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对啊！炸的是矿里，可——]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [WHAT BOSSU MEANS IS THAT THOSE OLD MINERS PLACED]
rows.current: Mauser: [波苏是说，老矿工在自己的矿井里埋了地雷，等于立块牌子：“这矿是我家的，谁也别碰！”]

rows.source: [MINES IN THEIR MINES, AS A WAY TO SAY "THAT'S MINE!"]

rows.current: Yiffai: [什么……？！总之我躲着它们就是了，行吧？！伊、伊吠通话结束！]

rows.current: Yiffai: [哇哦！总部那边有接到那声爆炸吗？！]

rows.current: Yiffai: [什么……？！那我就躲开它们，行吧？！伊、伊吠通话完毕！]

rows.current: Yiffany: [没办法让它们重新停用吗？]

rows.current: Bossu: [有两种办法。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [REALLY? GREAT! TELL ME HOW!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [真的？太好了！快告诉我怎么做！]

rows.source: [YOU CAN EITHER GET NEAR THEM SO THAT THEY DESTRUCT]
rows.current: Bossu: [你可以靠近它们，诱使它们自爆，或者打它们，让它们爆炸。你自己选。]

rows.speaker: Bossu

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT'S HARD FOR THEM TO BLEND IN FULLY, BUT THE OMEGOBIN]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们很难完全隐藏行迹，但欧米茄哥布林会试着躲进树冠里投掷投射物。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WILL TRY TO HIDE IN THE TREETOPS AND THROW PROJECTILES]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [JUST MAKE SURE TO DODGE AFTER THEY TOSS, OR YOU MAY]
rows.current: Bossu: [记得在它们投掷后闪避，否则你可能会发现自己成了它们下一个俘虏……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [FIND YOURSELF AS THEIR NEXT CAPTIVE...]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [A ROLLING BALL OF GRAVITY DEFYING TENTACLES]
rows.current: Bossu: [一团无视重力、滚来滚去的触手，乍看可能会让你爽上一回……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MAY SEEM LIKE A GOOD TIME IN THE MAKING...]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THE "ORBER" WILL ONLY CAUSE YOU A BIT OF PAIN.]
rows.current: Bossu: [可这「光球」只会让你有点疼。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YOU DON'T THINK YIFFAI YIFFAI, ACE STUDENT]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你该不会觉得，伊吠伊吠这个优等生还应付不了一两根小触手吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [COULD HANDLE A LITTLE TENTACLE OR TWO?]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IF I THOUGHT THAT YOU HAD THE OPTION, AGENT]
rows.current: Bossu: [特工，要是我觉得你有得选，我一定会全力支持你。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [I'D ENCOURAGE YOU WHOLE- HEARTEDLY.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THESE TENTACLES ARE BEST AVOIDED.]
rows.current: Bossu: [不过这些触手最好还是避开。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [啊呜……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT GIANT FLOATING HEAD RESEMBLES A GHOSTER]
rows.current: Bossu: [那巨大的漂浮头颅很像「幽灵者」，但似乎是更大的灵能扰动。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT SEEMS TO BE AN EVEN LARGER PSYCHIC DISTURBANCE.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU MUST BE GETTING NEAR WHATEVER HAS BEEN CAUSING]
rows.current: Bossu: [你一定正接近那个一直在引发图托恩上异常的源头，特工。小心！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE ANOMALIES ON TUTONE, AGENT. BE CAREFUL!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [EWW, GIANT SPIDERS?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [呕，巨型蜘蛛？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [FEAR NOT, THEY AREN'T REAL SPIDERS. ONLY ROBOTS.]
rows.current: Bossu: [别怕，它们不是真蜘蛛。只是机器人。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH BUT THEY'RE SHOOTING WEBS AT ME ALL THE SAME!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是啊，可它们照样朝我射蛛网！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [REAL SPIDERS DON'T HAVE THAT CAPABILITY TO BEGIN WITH]
rows.current: Bossu: [真蜘蛛压根没有这种本事，也不会有那种齿轮不停转动的声响和景象……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NOR WOULD THEY HAVE THE SOUND AND SIGHT]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [OF GEARS WHIRRING CONSTANTLY...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OKAY, SURE, BUT THESE SPIDERBOTS ARE STILL CREEPY!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好吧，可这些蜘蛛机器人还是很吓人！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE SPIDERBOT ADHESIVE IS WHAT YOU HAVE TO THANK]
rows.current: Bossu: [那片区域能维护得那么完好，你得感谢蜘蛛机器人的粘胶。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [FOR HOW PRISTINE THAT AREA IS MAINTAINED.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEIR NANO-WEBS HOLD TOGETHER THE ENVIRONMENT]
rows.current: Bossu: [即便它们的制造者早已退休多时，它们的纳米蛛网仍把整个环境粘在一起。]

rows.speaker: Bossu

rows.current: Bossu: [我们没有记录表明，有什么办法能瘫痪那些刺球，更别提摧毁它们了！]

rows.source: [SPIKEBALLS, MUCH LESS DESTROY THEM!]
[IF I DIDN'T KNOW BETTER, I'D THINK YOU WERE AN ESPER]

rows.current: Yiffany: [……得走了，拜拜！！]

rows.current: Yiffai: [这可不厚道！这么糟蹋和平的无人机。]

rows.current: Bossu: [我……不觉得它们介意，特工伊吠。要说的话，它们似乎正起劲地执行这项暴力新任务！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [EEP! I BETTER WATCH OUT FOR THEM, THEN!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [呀！那我最好当心它们！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IF YOU COME ACROSS ANY NEAR-SIGHTED BROWN FUR CRITTERS]
rows.current: Bossu: [要是你遇见近视的棕毛小动物，那些小家伙叫作「吱吱怪」]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE LITTLE FELLAS ARE CALLED "SQUEAKERS"]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY DON'T PUT UP MUCH OF A FIGHT, BUT THEY ARE KNOWN]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们打架不怎么样，不过出了名地专偷那些比自己慢半拍的家伙。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [TO STEAL FROM THOSE THAT ARE SOMEWHAT SLOWER THAN THEY.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [PHYSICALLY AND MENTALLY SLOWER, THAT IS.]
rows.current: Bossu: [我是说，动作和脑子都慢。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AHH, THAT SEEMS TO BE A SMALLER VERSION OF THE BLOCKER]
rows.current: Bossu: [啊，那似乎是Blocker的缩小版]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT SHOULD JUST AS IMPERVIOUS TO PHY- SICAL DAMAGE]
rows.current: Bossu: [它应该也一样对物理伤害免疫]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [JUST MAKE SURE YOU DON'T BUMP INTO THEM]
rows.current: Bossu: [只要确保你别撞到它们，那样它们就不应该构成太大的威胁。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AND THEY SHOULDN'T POSE MUCH OF A THREAT.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THIS FAST GROWING PLANT WILL USE ITS ENTIRE ENERGY STORE]
rows.current: Bossu: [这种疯长的植物会耗尽全部储能，只为把猎物围困起来。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO BLOCK IN PREY.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AFTER OTHER CREAT- URES HAVE TAKEN THE PREY OUT]
rows.current: Bossu: [等其他生物先把猎物解决掉，它就会从剩下的部分里尽量吸取能量。]

rows.speaker: Bossu

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [TAKE IT DOWN WITH- OUT BEING BOXED IN, IN ORDER TO SURVIVE]
rows.current: Bossu: [干掉它，但别被围住，才能活下来]
